notes.title: Book Two - Release Date
notes.notes:
It is time!

Follow the destructive path William intends for Aliena and watch Tom's and Philip's magnificent cathedral rise from the ashes! In times of political turmoil, decisions will be harsher and even death awaits in the gloom. It is time for Book Two of Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth!

The countdown to December 13th starts now!

See our release trailer here: https://youtu.be/Utl-zJfI9DE

notes.title: Book 2 and 3 Release Schedule
notes.notes:
Hi The Pillars of the Earth fans,

your feedback has been astonishing. We would like to thank you for your support!

We promised to update you on the release schedule of Book 2 and 3 during Gamescom. So here it comes.

Release Schedule for Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth:
Book 1: From the Ashes (available NOW)
Book 2: Sowing the Wind (available December 2017)
Book 3: Eye on the Storm (available Q1 2018)

Please remember: by purchasing the game Book 2 and 3 will be automatically added to your Steam library at no further cost on the date of their respective release.

Thank you
Uyu
